note: Derived products of rainier3d, freely redistributable with attribution. Filled by scripts/20_publish_products.py.

model.description: Fused 3D model: levels L1-L3 (Vp, Vs, rho, Qp, Qs, units, alteration, geology and regional inputs) and the surface layers, UTM 10N + NAVD88 (xarray DataTree, zarr v3)
model.license: CC-BY-4.0 (derived product); see docs/data_policy.md for each input
model.cite: Denolle, M., Yao, D., Hemmett, M., Köpfli, M., Han, S., and Kidiwela, M. (2026). rainier3d: a reproducible digital model of the subsurface and surface of Mount Rainier, Washington. https://github.com/Denolle-Lab/mt-rainier-digital-model

model_let.description: The fused model after the S37 local-earthquake tomography: Vp, Vs and rho of model with the smooth ln V update (dlnvp_let, dlnvs_let, zero in the top 150 m) and the node grid /let; same layout as model (xarray DataTree, zarr v3)
model_let.license: CC-BY-4.0 (derived product); see docs/data_policy.md for each input
model_let.cite: Denolle, M., Yao, D., Hemmett, M., Köpfli, M., Han, S., and Kidiwela, M. (2026). rainier3d: a reproducible digital model of the subsurface and surface of Mount Rainier, Washington. https://github.com/Denolle-Lab/mt-rainier-digital-model

grids.description: Uniform grids of the fused model for other codes (S9): CF netCDF at 500 m (vp, vs, rho, qp, qs, alteration, air, surface_elevation; UTM 10N, elevation up), EMC-style netCDF (lon, lat, depth), NonLinLoc P and S slowness grids

strain_3d.description: Strain in the model volume (S25), 500 m x 250 m grid: GNSS strain rate carried down (areal, volumetric, maximum shear, shortening azimuth, right-lateral shear on WRSZ-parallel planes) and the static strain of the edifice load (full tensor, volumetric, SHmax azimuth)

edifice_load.description: Stress from the weight of the edifice (Boussinesq half-space) on the model levels L1-L3 (S18)

alteration.description: Hydrothermal alteration of the edifice from the 1996 helicopter EM survey (S22): 3D intensity in the top 200 m, bedrock elevation, per-frequency resistivity and depth of investigation, apparent magnetisation (CF netCDF, UTM 10N)
alteration.license: CC-BY-4.0 (derived from USGS OFR 2000-27, public domain)
alteration.cite: as model; Rystrom et al. (2000), Finn et al. (2001)

mass_movements.description: Mass-movement catalogue of the model box (S24): events (landslides, lahars, debris flows, seismically recorded mass movements), flow deposits, faults, 1998 lahar hazard zones and a summary (GeoPackage and CSV)
mass_movements.license: CC-BY-4.0 for the compilation; the Washington Geological Survey layers are free to use with citation (WGS Disclaimers and Citation Guidelines; see docs/data_policy.md)
mass_movements.cite: as model; the sources listed in docs/mass_movements.md

gnss.schedule: weekly, Mondays 09:00 UTC (.github/workflows/gnss-weekly.yml); dated copies rainier3d_gnss_<as_of>.zip in the same release
gnss.description: GNSS station velocities (MIDAS, QC flags), strain-rate grid, daily regional strain series and the download manifest (S17, S18), refreshed weekly
gnss.cite: as model; GPS time series provided by the Pacific Northwest Geodetic Array, Central Washington University
